ceremonies.title: Dedication of Service
ceremonies.purpose: State a freely chosen commitment to learning and service.
ceremonies.practice: Choose a small service project and a review date.
ceremonies.status: Proposed voluntary ceremony; no automatic rank advancement

ceremonies.title: Reflection of Balance
ceremonies.purpose: Reflect on a difficult decision and acknowledge uncertainty.
ceremonies.practice: Record an alternative interpretation and a constructive next step.
ceremonies.status: Proposed voluntary ceremony; no automatic rank advancement

ceremonies.title: Recognition of Learning
ceremonies.purpose: Present a lesson learned and acknowledge its limitations.
ceremonies.status: Proposed voluntary ceremony; no automatic rank advancement

ceremonies.title: Dedication of Flame
ceremonies.purpose: Name a chosen ambition and the values that constrain its pursuit.
ceremonies.status: Proposed voluntary ceremony; no automatic rank advancement

ceremonies.title: Trial of Reflection
ceremonies.purpose: Examine a setback without disguising its consequences.
ceremonies.practice: Identify a revised strategy and a realistic review date.
ceremonies.status: Proposed voluntary ceremony; no automatic rank advancement

ceremonies.title: Recognition of Achievement
ceremonies.tagline: Master yourself, and no throne is necessary.
ceremonies.purpose: Describe an achievement and the discipline that made it possible.
ceremonies.practice: Identify evidence of progress and acknowledge assistance received.
ceremonies.status: Proposed voluntary ceremony; no automatic rank advancement
